posts.text:
Wishing all who celebrate a blessed and joyful Eid al-Adha!

I hope today brings you peace and love among family and neighbors. Eid Mubarak!

Big Tech spent at least $653 MILLION to cozy up to Trump and Republicans — and now they’re cashing in BIG.

This is the oligarchy in action and we must fight back by overturning Citizens United, abolishing Super PACs, and implementing serious regulations on AI.

Video

The Trump administration has weaponized the DOJ to go after their political enemies and protect their billionaire buddies — all with no checks from the Supreme Court or Republicans in Congress.

This cannot continue. Congress must step up and enforce our checks and balances.

Video

Trump isn’t going after the “worst of the worst” — he’s going after all immigrants. And we must be clear eyed about this — he’s using immigrants as a testing ground for stripping Constitutional protections for ALL of us.

Video

Kids should be playing with their friends, learning at school, and going home to see their families. No child should be ripped away from their family, held in detention.

Any country that detains children has lost its moral compass.

Video

Trump is acting like an authoritarian — and it’s not just hurting us here at home, it’s affecting people across the globe. 

From his illegal war of choice in Iran to the boat strikes in the Caribbean, he is acting without respect for democracy or the rule of law.

Video

The President of the United States traded TENS of MILLIONS of dollars in stocks this year.

This should be illegal. Members of Congress, the President, and Vice President should ALL be banned from trading stocks. That’s why I’m leading bipartisan efforts to do just that.

Video

As Americans come together for cookouts this long weekend, they’re paying more for the basics. 

Thanks to Trump’s illegal war and inflation, grocery prices are up on everything from corn to sodas.

This Memorial Day, we remember and honor the brave servicemembers who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country.

We keep them and their families in our hearts.

Thanks to Trump and Republicans’ refusal to extend the ACA subsidies, ACA premiums are up 58% this year, leading 5 million Americans to forgo health care coverage altogether.

In the richest country in the world, no one should worry about being able to afford a trip to the doctor.

Democrats are spotlighting the ongoing legal effort to break up the Live Nation-Ticketmaster monopoly.

I questioned a former Trump DOJ official who confirmed that outside corporate lobbying likely resulted in the surprise DOJ settlement.

We must keep up this fight. ticketnews.com/2026/05/lawma…

There are specific visas that were created to ensure that survivors of trafficking and domestic violence could remain safely in the US.
 
Backlogs and arbitrary caps combined with Trump’s cruel mass detention campaign mean that too often these people are languishing in detention. This is unacceptable and goes against the whole point of these programs.

Video

The Supreme Court’s recent ruling in Louisiana v. Callais lets states systematically dilute the power of Black and Brown voters through gerrymandering.

It is an insult to Black and Brown Americans and threatens our democracy.

Video

ICYMI: The DOJ-Trump agreement that will create a $1.8 billion slush fund to pay off Jan 6 insurrectionists and Trump’s cronies also blocks the IRS from pursuing any action against Trump or his family for violations of tax law.

Corruption in the highest form. commondreams.org/news/trump-…

This week, Republican Nancy Mace introduced a bill to ban naturalized citizens from government service.

This is insulting to the hundreds of thousands of constituents who voted for a naturalized citizen and ignores the fact that all of us, besides Native Americans, are descended from immigrants.

commondreams.org/news/nancy-…

NEW POD: I sat down with the Executive Director of the ACLU of Louisiana, Alanah Odoms, to discuss Louisiana v. Callais, the impact of the gutting of the Voting Rights Act, and how we move forward.

Watch at the link in my story or listen wherever you get your podcasts.
piped.video/watch?v=jrq8746j…

Trump’s racist rhetoric targeting Indian and Chinese Americans and immigrants is unacceptable.

This is all to distract from Republicans’ failure to help Americans who cannot afford gas or groceries. Co-leading legislation to condemn this disgusting language.

14 U.S. Catholic Bishops sent a letter to Congress in opposition of Republicans’ DHS funding bill.

Read their powerful words in defense of immigrants:
